product_metadata.title: Taper Candle Sharpener - Make All Candles Fit Into Your Candlestick Holders - Perfect for Centerpices, Holiday Decor, and Gifts
description: Great solution for a stubborn taper candles that won't fit into your candlestick holders Shave off ends to fit in candlestick without ruining the candle Works like a pencil sharpener narrowing the candle base for a better fit Perfect for all holidays to make sure your candles are ready for decorations - also great for housewarming, gifts, stocking stuffers, etc. Made of durable acrylic material - 2" high
